apps.name: StepTuDeen
apps.short: An Islamic digital platform bringing together the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and mosque services.
apps.description:
StepTuDeen is a free, open source Islamic web app. It aims to make the Quran, Hadith and everyday religious needs available in one place. The app is currently in its experimental stage.

Holy Quran: full recitation, translations in Urdu and other languages, Tafsir Ibn Kathir, offline reading, last-read ayah saving and search.

Hadith Books: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Jami at-Tirmidhi, Sunan Abi Dawud, Sunan Ibn Majah, Sunan an-Nasai, Riyad as-Salihin, Muwatta Imam Malik and Al-Adab al-Mufrad, with grading labels.

Prayer Times: five daily prayers, countdown to the next prayer, nearby mosques, Friday times and Adhan/Iqamah notifications. Imam Dashboard for mosque registration and timing settings.

Other features: Qibla direction, duas and adhkar, digital tasbih, and saved favourite surahs and Hadith bookmarks.

apps.name: RochTools
apps.short: Free browser-based tools for creators: video downloader, password generator, QR code, word counter, color picker and Base64.
apps.description:
RochTools is a collection of professional tools designed for creators. All tools run entirely in your browser with zero data upload to any server. Everything is free and needs no sign-up.

Video Downloader: download HD videos from popular platforms without watermarks.

Password Generator: create strong passwords with adjustable length, multiple character types and a strength meter.

QR Code Generator and Scanner: create QR codes from text or URLs, and scan them from images or the camera.

Word Counter: count words, characters and sentences, with reading time and keyword frequency.

Color Picker: pick colors and copy HEX, RGB and HSL codes, with a history of your last 20 colors.

Base64 Encoder/Decoder: convert text and files to Base64 and decode them back.
